description: This file is a wrapper for <sys/dirent.h> providing directory traversal functions and definitions for Windows and POSIX systems, including directory entry structures, constants, and functions like opendir, readdir, and closedir.

methods.name: opendir
methods.description: Opens a directory stream for reading directory entries, handling Windows and POSIX systems.

methods.name: readdir
methods.description: Reads the next directory entry from the directory stream.
